propositions: Core commands across _commands, _engine_support, and _io modules parse argv imperatively, duplicating grammar that should be centralized in argparse factories.

Each migrated core command must wire its S2a-compliant parser factory onto the Route.parser_factory field in _registry.py and route its runtime handler through that factory, preserving per-family unknown-token semantics (skip vs reject-exit-2).

Router-level global flag extraction (--output, --quiet, --allow-secret-pattern) runs before per-command factories see argv; per-command factories parse only the post-extraction tail and do not re-declare globals.

Parser factories must preserve all pre-migration behavior including accepted/rejected argv matrices, diagnostic text, streams, and exit codes, verified through real production-path tests without any unapproved behavioral deltas.
Each parser family (factory module + Route wiring + handler switch) forms one revertable unit with no cross-family coupling and no imports of domain executors or optional dependencies.
